tha-ap360:1.1: Sajjhadāyaka.] Vipassino bhagavato lokajeṭṭhassa tādino / ekaṃ sajjhaṃ mayā dinnaṃ pasannena sapāṇinā. // //
tha-ap360:2.1: Hatthiyānaṃ assayānaṃ dibbayānaṃ samajjhagaṃ / tena sajjhakadānena patto 'mhi āsavakkhayaṃ. // //
tha-ap360:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ sajjham adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi sajjhadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap360:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Sajjhadāyako thero i. g. a-ti. Sajjhadāyakattherassa
